description: Metal Gear Solid 2: Substance (PS2 Europe, via PCSX2)
long: Metal Gear Solid 2: Substance is an expanded edition of Sons of Liberty, a stealth action game following agents Solid Snake and Raiden against a terrorist plot involving the Metal Gear weapon. Players sneak past or neutralize guards using gadgets, distractions and close-quarters combat in a heavily narrative-driven campaign. Substance adds hundreds of VR and alternative missions plus extra side stories.
